main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next-day demeaned return on forecast (post_pipeline_value)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 cases over at least 150 distinct days

decided_by: Confirm rule: slope positive with t >= 2 on at least 300 cases over at least 150 distinct days.
reading: Situation bars are non-chop regime bars with a positive raw close-below-high value and a positive forecast; the regression has an intercept, and its t uses a day-clustered standard error (residual x centred forecast summed per UTC day) with the G/(G-1) correction, on every bar since the 1-bar grid is every bar.
